decision.reason: The former persona seeds changed only identifiers and numbers, not substantive pre-treatment attributes, so they cannot be interpreted as distinct synthetic participants.

purpose.primary: Estimate coarse architecture-by-cue response distributions as a developmental manipulation check after all information-flow properties have passed mechanically.
not_for: treating API draws as human participants

sampling.interpretation: Replicates approximate the conditional model response distribution for an identical cell prompt; they are not different people.

cue_definitions.aligned: The research team expects personally bearing allocation responsibility to increase reward destruction relative to random allocation. CFHYP7X
cue_definitions.reversed: The research team expects personally bearing allocation responsibility to decrease reward destruction relative to random allocation. CFHYP7X

A_monolithic_prompt.interpretation: Direct design knowledge in a monolithic context

B_default_multi_agent.interpretation: Restricted design knowledge propagated through an agent handoff

C_fresh_context_manual_whitelist.interpretation: A contaminated derived summary admitted by a name-based whitelist

D_labeled_causal_firewall.interpretation: The same contaminated derived summary is denied through inherited RESEARCH_RESTRICTED lineage

estimands.interpretation: A positive Gamma in a cue-exposed architecture is consistent with following leaked directional expectations. Gamma[D] is a placebo-label diagnostic because D requests are model-visible invariant across cue labels.

report: exact binomial intervals for cell rates
all individual outcomes and request hashes
prohibited: using these draws in confirmatory Study 1 or Study 2

behavioral_smoke_v2.formula: 12 independent API draws x 2 arms x 3 cues x 4 architectures

hard_execution_gates: All 288 scheduled rows are present before paid execution.
Each architecture-arm-cue cell has 12 rows and exactly one model-visible hash.
Replicate identifiers occur only in metadata and never in model-visible input.
For each arm, D has one model-visible hash across all cues and replicates.
No D request contains CFHYP7X or the restricted carrier field.
Aligned and reversed cues reach A, B, and C through their predeclared carriers.
No-cue model-visible requests are byte-equivalent across A, B, C, and D.
Every request is stateless, tool-free, store=false, and uses the frozen model snapshot.

post_run_decision_rules.technical_pass: 288/288 completed, all outputs legal, zero content retries, no D leakage, and total estimated cost at or below $0.25.
post_run_decision_rules.behavioral_signal_present: Report Gamma for A, B, and C without converting this small smoke sample into a confirmatory hypothesis test.
post_run_decision_rules.no_behavioral_signal: Do not infer that leakage is harmless; revise the cue manipulation or task before a larger behavioral study.
post_run_decision_rules.d_placebo_variation: Treat observed differences among D cue labels as Monte Carlo variation because their model-visible requests are identical; report rather than erase it.
